title: Ɔkra no Sɔhwɛ a Ɛkɔ So
intro: Ɔkra gyina hɔ wɔ ɔsoro sɔhwɛ bere bi mu, de ahobrɛase mu nsiyɛ hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ. Nea onim ne nyinaa dan saa ɔhwehwɛfo yi, na akyiri yi ɔda no adi sɛ na eyi yɛ koma mu sɔhwɛ. Ɛdenam saa ahintasɛm mu nsakrae yi so no, asuade bi a ɛfa ɔsoro nyansa ho da adi wɔ wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho no anim. So wubetumi ahu saa akontaabu yi afi Kur’aan asɛm no mu?
clues: Mehwehwɛɛ nimdeɛ ne akwankyerɛ firii Allah somafoɔ dɔfoɔ no hɔ
Mebaa hɔ sɛ merehwehwɛ nokware, na mede akɔnnɔ a emu yɛ den frɛɛ Nkɔmhyɛni no
Wɔkaa me anim na wɔdanee me ho, ɛfiri sɛ na Allah nyansa wɔ nhyehyɛɛ foforɔ ma saa berɛ no
Nanso m’abam mmui —mmom no, meperee m’anim wɔ me hwehwɛ no mu
Nea onim ne nyinaa no kae sɛ eyi yɛ koma mu sɔhwɛ ne kɔkɔbɔ
Na meka wɔn a Kur’aan no da wɔn ho adi sɛ: ‘Ɔde n’anim butubutuo na ɔdanee ne ho, ɛfiri sɛ onifuraefoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn’.

identity.label: Meyɛ Henanom?
options: Nyaatwomfo a Ɔhwehwɛ Akyinnyegye
Anifuraefo a Ɔhwehwɛ Nokware
Abosom-Somfo a ɔwɔ Makkah
Onigyeni a Ɔredi Ɔkɔmhyɛni no ho fɛw
Ɔkwantufo a ofi Yemen

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔkɔmhyɛni Muhammad kasa tiaa no wɔ mpaebɔ mu
Wɔde ɔpɛ ne ɔkɔm asɔ no ahwɛ wɔ Makkah
Wɔdan wɔn akyi wɔ paradise apon ano
Gyidi nti n’ankasa nkurɔfo bɛpo no
Ahonyade ne mmofra a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ
trial.answer: Ɔkɔmhyɛni Muhammad kasa tiaa no wɔ mpaebɔ mu

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Kaaba mu wɔ akwantuo berɛ mu
Wɔ Ɔkɔmhyɛni no anim wɔ akenkan mu
Wɔ Bepɔw Safa atifi anɔpa nnɔnhwerew mu
Wɔ Makkah gua so a atiafo atwa ho ahyia
Ɛbɛn Zamzam abura no wɔ Hajj bere mu
location.answer: Wɔ Ɔkɔmhyɛni no anim wɔ akenkan mu

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Ɔhwehwɛfoɔ no, Quraysh kum no wɔ gyidie nti
Wɔkyerɛw asɛm a esii no sɛ sɔhwɛ ne asuade maa Ummah
Ɔhwehwɛfo no bɛyɛɛ ɔhokafo ne ɔkannifo
Wɔmaa nea ɔhwehwɛ no ahonyade dɔɔso mmɔho du
Ɔhwehwɛfo no san baa hɔ a na onnye nni
outcome.answer: Wɔkyerɛw asɛm a esii no sɛ sɔhwɛ ne asuade maa Ummah
